## What's Changed

* Detect Linux text capabilities through standard AT-SPI interfaces, improving text operations on Ubuntu 24.04. ([#51](https://github.com/iFurySt/open-codex-computer-use/issues/51))
* Preserve URL-bearing Web link action nodes in macOS accessibility snapshots so navigable links retain independent element indexes. ([#58](https://github.com/iFurySt/open-codex-computer-use/pull/58))

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/iFurySt/open-codex-computer-use/compare/v0.3.1...v0.3.2
